### Itô Formula

:::{.definition data-title="Itô Formula"}

For an [[ito-process]] that satisfies the
[[stochastic-calculus|stochastic differential equation]]
$$
dX_t=\mu_tdt+\sigma_tdB_t
$$
where $B_t$ is a [[wiener-process-brownian-motion]], for a twice-differentiable
scalar function $f(t,x)$ of two real variables $t$ and $x$ one has
$$
df(t,X_t)=\frac{\partial f}{\partial t}dt+\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}dX_t+\frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial x^2}dX_t^2
$$
where $dX_t^2$ denotes the [[p-th-variation|quadratic variation]] of $X_t$.  

:::

We evaluate $(dX_{t})^2 = (dX_{t})\cdot (dX_{t})$ is computed according to the
rules
$$
dt\cdot dt = dt\cdot dB_{t}=dB_{t}\cdot dt=0,\quad dB_{t}\cdot dB_{t}=dt.
$$
